verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official Apps SDK for building apps inside the editor, with a quickstart and an official CLI for creating and managing apps, plus distribution via the Apps Marketplace or private team sharing. For the Connect APIs, however, Canva provides only an OpenAPI description that developers run through code-generation tools to produce their own client SDKs, rather than first-party language SDKs. Missing for 10: official prebuilt client SDKs for the Connect APIs, documented language coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
